questions.q: What changes when you know God by name, not just as God Almighty?
questions.answer: God isn't just the most powerful being out there; he's personal. He told Moses his name, the Lord, and showed he remembers his covenant with his people.

questions.q: How would one personal God change what you believe about right and wrong?
questions.answer: Right and wrong wouldn't be something we make up. It would come from God himself, so we don't get to decide what's right, only whether we'll follow it.

questions.q: How would one caring, personal God change how you treat friends and family?
questions.answer: One example: since God keeps pursuing me even after I mess up, I could be quicker to forgive a friend or sibling and keep reaching out instead of giving up on them.
